cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Let Go of the Grudge
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender resentment, distance, or a claim that keeps the relationship stuck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Let me help you move. Missing your birthday shouldn't mean I'm banned from every box.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I needed you then. You didn't show.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I know. I'm here now. Give me one thing you can bear to trust me with.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The birthday glasses. Still wrapped, since nobody came.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll carry them carefully. Could we unwrap two at your new place?

mechanism: A claims authority to end exclusion while allowing B to choose the first small task through which trust can restart.
confusable: D73 merely asks involvement; D84 confronts a resentment-based ban and seeks its surrender.
comparison: Birthday glasses entrusted during a move differ from sharing dinner while hearing about a missed performance.
seedUse: Use D84-b painful glasses becoming a possible shared use, preserving A responsibility for the old absence.
